pred_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.School,
       s.CharterNum,
       sat.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Ranking
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT f.`School Name`
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

WITH diffs AS (
    SELECT s.School AS school_name,
           s.DOCType AS doc_type,
           f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Local'
)
SELECT school_name, doc_type
FROM diffs
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM diffs)

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score,
       s.Phone AS communication_number
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31'
   OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Phone

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
  AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.AdmFName1 AS first_name, s.AdmLName1 AS last_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.County,
           sat.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 12 AS monthly_avg_schools_opened
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND OpenDate LIKE '1980%'

SELECT s.School, AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'
  AND StatusType = 'Merged'

SELECT `School Name`,
       `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9'

SELECT GSoffered
FROM schools
WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS SchoolCount
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY SchoolCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic'
  AND l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format = 'gladiator'
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL

SELECT l.status
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage'

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
       f.`District Code`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR s.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
ORDER BY COUNT(r.id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS school_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN s.CDSCode END) AS multiple_provision_schools
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND s.City IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND c.borderColor = 'white'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*')
  AND text LIKE '%triggered ability%'

SELECT st.language
FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.baseSetSize = 180
  AND s.block = 'Ravnica'

SELECT T1.type
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.language = 'German'
  AND T2.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.supertypes IS NOT NULL

SELECT id, percentage
FROM (
    SELECT id, isTextless,
           100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () / COUNT(*) OVER () AS percentage
    FROM cards
    WHERE isStorySpotlight = 1
)
WHERE isTextless = 0
ORDER BY id
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'legal'

SELECT DISTINCT st.language
FROM set_translations AS st
JOIN sets AS s ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.mcmName = 'Archenemy'
  AND s.code = 'ARC'
SELECT DISTINCT language FROM foreign_data WHERE name = 'A Pedra Fellwar'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM sets s
INNER JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Ice Age'
  AND st.language = 'Italian'
  AND st.translation IS NOT NULL

SELECT name, convertedManaCost
FROM cards
WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper')
ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(s.isForeignOnly) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS only_available_outside_us
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM cards c
    JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_korean_version

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM sets s
WHERE s.baseSetSize < 10
  AND s.code IN (
      SELECT st.setCode
      FROM set_translations st
      WHERE st.language = 'Italian'
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT DISTINCT c.artist
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c.convertedManaCost > 5
  AND (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'Coldsnap'

SELECT fd.name
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  AND fd.language = 'Italian'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
      SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
      FROM cards c2
      WHERE c2.setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Coldsnap')
  )

SELECT c.name, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE c.edhrecRank = 1
  AND l.status = 'Banned'

SELECT s.name
FROM sets s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.language = 'Korean'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.language LIKE '%Japanese%'
)

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE CreationDate >= '2011-01-01' AND CreationDate < '2012-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.name, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM users
WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01'

SELECT c.name,
       c.frameVersion,
       l.format,
       l.status
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN legalities AS l
       ON l.uuid = c.uuid
      AND l.status = 'Banned'
WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams'

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS elder_owned_percentage
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

SELECT p.Id AS PostId,
       CASE WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS WellFinished
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 23853
  AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON u.Id = v.UserId
WHERE v.Id = 6347

SELECT ViewCount
FROM posts
WHERE Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Text = 'thank you user93!'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM badges
    WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Name) > 5
) AS sub

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Name)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(Name) AS PercentageDifference
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Student'

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(u.UpVotes) AS REAL) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_upvotes,
    CAST(SUM(u.Age) AS REAL) / COUNT(u.Id) AS avg_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserId
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
    HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
)

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(ph.Id) = COUNT(DISTINCT ph.PostId)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio_2010_to_2011
FROM votes

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.DisplayName
ORDER BY SUM(p.ViewCount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.Tags
FROM posts AS p
INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p.CommentCount = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Community'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) AS ViewCountDifference
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos')

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(pl.Id) AS REAL) / 12 AS avg_monthly_links_2010
FROM postLinks pl
JOIN posts p ON pl.PostId = p.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', pl.CreationDate) = '2010'
  AND p.AnswerCount <= 2

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE b.Name = 'Autobiographer'
ORDER BY b.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, p.Title
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.Id, u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS UserCount
FROM users AS u
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'United Kingdom'
  AND p.FavoriteCount >= 4

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011'

SELECT DISTINCT u.Reputation, u.UpVotes
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text = 'fine, you win :)'

SELECT p.ViewCount AS TotalViews,
       u.DisplayName AS UserName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer Game Datasets'

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS zero_score_comments
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CommentCount = 1
  AND c.Score = 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM comments AS c
INNER JOIN users AS u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10

SELECT y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY y.CustomerID
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) AS Month,
       SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth AS y
JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2)
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 6
  AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS banned_total
    FROM legalities
    WHERE status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY format
),
top_format AS (
    SELECT format
    FROM banned_counts
    WHERE banned_total = (SELECT MAX(banned_total) FROM banned_counts)
)
SELECT l.format, c.name
FROM legalities AS l
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
  AND l.format IN (SELECT format FROM top_format)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS more_sme_czk_than_eur
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment,
       (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS Percentage_Increase
FROM seg
ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2013-06%'

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS y
  ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.Currency
FROM "transactions_1k" t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cze_transactions
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
  AND t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'

SELECT c.Segment
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23'
  AND t.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT g.Country
FROM "transactions_1k" AS t
INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24'
  AND t.Price = 548.4

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(Segment) = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK'

SELECT t.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) AS total_spent,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH c AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
y AS (
    SELECT SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS yr, SUM(Consumption) AS cons
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM c)
      AND SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY yr
)
SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN cons END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN cons END))
       / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN cons END) AS decrease_rate
FROM y

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal
GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT L.name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,

),
bal AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t
         WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
           AND t.date <= '1993-03-22'
         ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS bal_start,
        (SELECT t.balance FROM trans t
         WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM acc)
           AND t.date <= '1998-12-27'
         ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS bal_end
)

champs AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driverId
    FROM last_races lr
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = lr.raceId AND ds.position = 1
)
SELECT c.year,
       AVG(
           CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1, 2) AS REAL) * 60
         + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 4) AS REAL)
